mapper.select: select tree_id, species, grade, chest, survey_id, survey_date,u.username,latitude,longitude, ST_AsText(geom) as geomText, ST_Distance(d.geom::geography,ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude},#{latitude}),4326)::geography) as distance from diseased_trees d left join users u on d.survey_id = u.user_id where ST_DWithin(d.geom::geography,ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude},#{latitude}),4326)::geography,#{radius}) order by distance

SELECT tree_id, species, grade, chest, survey_id, survey_date, longitude, latitude FROM diseased_trees where tree_id IN
#{id}

select to_char(date_trunc('month',survey_date),'YYYY-MM') AS month, count(*) as newCount, sum(count(*)) over (order by date_trunc('month',survey_date)) AS cumulativeCount, AVG(longitude) as centerLng, AVG(latitude) as centerLat from diseased_trees WHERE survey_date IS NOT NULL group by date_trunc('month',survey_date) order by month

select TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', d.survey_date), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS newCount, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', d.survey_date)) AS cumulativeCount, AVG(d.longitude) AS centerLng, AVG(d.latitude) AS centerLat FROM diseased_trees d
inner join admin_region r on ST_Within(d.geom,r.geom) where r.gb_code = #{gbCode} AND r.level = 'province'
INNER JOIN city c ON ST_Within(d.geom, c.geom) WHERE c.gb_code = #{gbCode}
WHERE 1 = 0
AND d.survey_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', d.survey_date) ORDER BY month
